description: This Java source file defines the StreamingActor class, which is an Akka actor responsible for managing WebSocket streaming sessions, delegating message handling to session actors, and managing streaming configuration within a distributed system. It includes methods for creating actors, handling connection requests, retrieving WebSocket configurations, and updating session counters.

classes.name: StreamingActor
classes.description: An Akka actor responsible for managing WebSocket streaming sessions, configuration, and coordination within a distributed system environment.

methods.name: props
methods.description: Factory method to create Props for instantiating the StreamingActor with all required dependencies.

methods.name: supervisorStrategy
methods.description: Returns the supervisor strategy for this actor, defining how it handles failures.

methods.name: createReceive
methods.description: Defines the message handling behavior, combining configuration retrieval, modification, connection, and metrics update handlers.

methods.name: getConfig
methods.description: Returns the current streaming configuration as a Config object.

methods.name: setConfig
methods.description: Updates the streaming configuration with a new Config object, rescheduling any periodic tasks.

methods.name: getUniqueChildActorName
methods.description: Generates a unique name for child actor based on a connection correlation ID.

methods.name: scheduleScrapeStreamSessionsCounter
methods.description: Schedules periodic updates for the stream session counter metric.

methods.name: replyWebSocketConfig
methods.description: Replies with the current WebSocket configuration to the requester.

methods.name: updateStreamingSessionsCounter
methods.description: Updates the gauge for current active streaming sessions based on child actors.
